note: Every room.workspace.* action ocean-bedrock stamps on a room event stream: the PRODUCER set, derived from the WORKSPACE_EVENT_ACTIONS table beside emitWorkspaceEvent in src/server.mjs and held equal to it by test/room-event-actions.test.mjs. The stream carries more than this list -- a room's messages ride the identical correlation_id and virtual_path pair, which is what makes them the same stream -- so read this as the workspace slice of a room's events, not as everything a reader of that stream will see. A consumer allowlist is expected to be a SUBSET of this, and a smaller one is not a defect on its face -- ocean-os deliberately ignores several of these when deciding what becomes a room marker, because file_written and file_deleted are keystrokes, exec_* is chatter an agent would read back as its own typing, and a *_started doubles the operation it opens. Read that repo's own rationale before filing its omissions as a bug against this list. What IS a defect: an action emitted here that a consumer has never seen, because an unlisted action is dropped silently and a new event then reads downstream as nothing having happened.
